# NPC Builder Templates

## Quick NPC Generation

### Step 1: Role (select one)
- Commoner: Farmer, merchant, craftsman
- Soldier: Guard, soldier, captain
- Scholar: Mage, priest, sage
- Criminal: Thief, bandit, assassin
- Noble: Lord, lady, advisor
- Monster: Creature type

### Step 2: Stats (roll or assign)
| Stat | Commoner | Soldier | Scholar | Criminal | Noble |
|------|---------|---------|---------|-----------|-------|
| STR | 10 | 14 | 8 | 10 | 10 |
| DEX | 10 | 12 | 10 | 14 | 10 |
| CON | 10 | 12 | 8 | 10 | 10 |
| INT | 10 | 10 | 14 | 10 | 12 |
| WIS | 10 | 12 | 14 | 10 | 12 |
| CHA | 10 | 10 | 10 | 12 | 14 |

### Step 3: HP
- Commoner: 4 (1d8)
- Soldier: 11 (2d8+2)
- Scholar: 4 (1d8)
- Criminal: 9 (2d8)
- Noble: 9 (2d8)

### Step 4: Equipment
- Commoner: Simple clothes, tool
- Soldier: Martial weapon, armor
- Scholar: Arcane focus, spellbook
- Criminal: Light weapons, thieves tools
- Noble: Fine clothes, signet ring

### Step 5: Features
- Unique quirk (1)
- Secret (1)
- Goal (1)
- Bond (1)

## NPC Examples

### Guard Captain
```
STR 14 (+2), DEX 12 (+1), CON 12 (+1)
INT 10 (+0), WIS 13 (+1), CHA 12 (+1)
AC 18 (chain mail + shield)
HP 30 (5d8+10)
Weapon: Longsword +4 (1d8+2)
Skills: Perception +3, Intimidation +3
Feature: Tactical Leader ( allies in range have +2)
```

### Village Elder
```
STR 8 (-1), DEX 10 (+0), CON 10 (+0)
INT 14 (+2), WIS 16 (+3), CHA 12 (+1)
AC 10
HP 16 (3d8+3)
Skills: Insight +5, Medicine +5, Persuasion +3
Feature: Healer (restore 1d4+2 as action)
```

### Thieves Guild Member
```
STR 10 (+0), DEX 16 (+3), CON 10 (+0)
INT 12 (+1), WIS 11 (+0), CHA 10 (+0)
AC 15 (leather)
HP 18 (4d8)
Weapon: Shortsword +5 (1d6+3)
Skills: Stealth +5, Sleight +5, Acro +3
Feature: Cunning Action (bonus action dash/dash)
```

### Wizard Apprentice
```
STR 8 (-1), DEX 12 (+1), CON 10 (+0)
INT 15 (+2), WIS 12 (+1), CHA 10 (+0)
AC 12
HP 8 (2d8)
Spells: Fire Bolt (1d10), Shield, Magic Missile
Skills: Arcana +4, Investigation +2
Feature: Ritual Casting (cast detect magic at will)
```


### Bandit Leader
```
STR 14 (+2), DEX 14 (+2), CON 12 (+1)
INT 10 (+0), WIS 10 (+0), CHA 12 (+1)
AC 15 (leather)
HP 28 (6d8+2)
Weapon: Scimitar +4 (1d6+2), Shortbow +4 (1d6+2)
Skills: Intimidation +3, Athletics +4
Feature: Multiattack
```


### Priest
```
STR 10 (+0), DEX 10 (+0), CON 10 (+0)
INT 10 (+0), WIS 15 (+2), CHA 14 (+2)
AC 13 (chain shirt)
HP 22 (4d8+4)
Spells: Cure Wounds (1d6+3), Guidance, Light
Skills: Religion +4, Insight +4
Feature: Healer (as order)
```

## Quick Personality

### Quirks
- Always polish weapon
- Stories with every subject
- Nervous laugh
- Speaks in rhymes
- Obsessed with cleanliness
- Superstitious
- Constantly eating
- Hums while working
- Fidgets with coin
- Avoids eye contact

### Secrets
- Wanted criminal
- Secret religion
- Hidden inheritance
- Traitor to faction
- Secretly magical
- In debt to criminals
- Spy for enemy
- Haunted by past
- Terminal illness
- Secret identity

### Goals
- Wealth
- Power
- Revenge
- Redemption
- Recognition
- Knowledge
- Family
- Freedom
- Peace
- Adventure
